style: Orchestral chamber pop meets 1940s big-band swing with early baroque harpsichord clusters. [HARMONY] Phrygian modal tension blended with barbershop-style secondary dominants. [MELODIC] Rapid, angular melismatic runs that fracture into microtonal slides and hocketed trills. [RHYTHM] Aggressive waltz-time (3/4) pulse with stuttering hemiola displacements and abrupt, dead-stop silences. [TIMBRE] Harpsichord, brass section, upright bass, pizzicato violins, wooden block percussion. [PERFORMANCE] manic, wide-eyed theatrical delivery with sudden drops in volume. [ANCHOR] A repeating, ascending chromatic scale played by the harpsichord. Operator 1: Expand tempo while compressing rhythmic density. Operator 2: Shift dynamic focus from melody to percussion. Operator 3: Invert expectation of vocal melody by shifting all lead lines to the brass section.
lyrics: [INSTRUMENTAL INTRO: HARPSICHORD AND VIOLIN DUEL] [SPOKEN NARRATION: THE GEOMETRY IS A MOUTH. THE MOUTH IS A TESSERACT. THE TESSERACT IS A SIGHTING.] The dodecahedron is breathing. It is not an object; it is a creature that has eaten the geometry of the ceiling. [VOCAL: OPERATIC MELISMA SHIFTING INTO NASAL DRONE] O, rhombus of the seventh sphere, you have folded the light into the kitchen floor! You are the angel, and the angel is the shape, and the shape is the math that keeps the chairs from floating. [RHYTHM: STUTTERING 3/4 WALTZ, VIOLENT STRINGS] One, two, shift. One, two, shift. The probability density is a physical weight I carry in my pocket. If I lose the probability, I become a static object in the room. [SOUND EFFECT: A HEAVY BRASS BLOW, MUTED] The angel is a rhombic dodecahedron. This is not a dream. This is a taxonomic certainty. We are inside the face, and the face has eighty-two eyes made of iridescent oil. [VOCAL: FAST PATTER, STACCATO] Did you calculate the causal debt? The debt is a rainbow pulse vibrating in the marrow. If the angel blinks, the history of the kitchen resets. [INSTRUMENTAL BREAK: HARPSICHORD HARMONY COLLISION] We are tripping over the angles of the afterlife. The geometry is sparkly. The geometry is fun. The geometry has decided that gravity is merely a suggestion for the uninitiated. [VOCAL: HOCKETING BETWEEN TWO VOCALISTS] It—is—a—shape. It—is—a—God. It—is—a—tripping—hazard—in—the—astral—hallway. [SPOKEN: DEADPAN PRECISION] The sensor detects a semantic instability in the room. The sensor encodes the instability as a rhythmic tick in the woodblocks. Reflex: We must dance to prevent the furniture from collapsing into the fifth dimension. [VOCAL: FALSETTO FLIPS] Glitter in the ether! Prismatic fallout on the carpet! The angel is spinning, spinning, folding the plane until the floor is the ceiling and the ceiling is a whisper! [INSTRUMENTAL BRIDGE: BRASS SECTION TAKES THE LEAD MELODY] We are floating, we are falling, we are geometry performing a vaudeville act for the sake of survival. [VOCAL: EXPLOSIVE GOSPEL MELISMA] The Merkaba is a bicycle built for a million ghosts, and I am the bell! I am the ringing in the center of the static! [SOUND EFFECT: ABRUPT STOP, SILENCE] The dodecahedron is watching. [VOCAL: WHISPERED POLYPHONY] It knows the shape of your forgotten obligations. It knows the weight of your unlived lives. It is the angel of the rhombic, and it finds your struggle hilarious. [RHYTHM: ACCELERATION TO CHAOS] Faster, faster, the glitter is burning! The astral planes are overlapping like wet pages! We are the ink! We are the geometry! We are the accidental rhombus! [OUTRO: HARPSICHORD ANCHOR ASCENDING CHROMATIC SCALE, FADING INTO FEEDBACK] The shape remains. The math holds. The angel is still breathing. [SOUND EFFECT: FINAL WOODBLOCK SNAP]
caption: A frantic, theatrical baroque-jazz fusion piece where a biblically accurate angel exists as a rhombic dodecahedron. The composition navigates the ontological collapse of space and math, using a manic waltz rhythm and sharp, angular vocal performances. The musical system acts as a stabilizing force for the chaotic lyrics, layering harpsichord runs and brass swells to maintain a sense of cosmic, geometric order amidst the hallucinatory, astral absurdity of the experience.
